edges.reason: Put reads msg.sender to index the Acc mapping.
Put consumes the _unlockTime argument when setting acc.unlockTime.
Put loads the local storage reference acc before writing to it.
Local acc aliases Acc[msg.sender] state variable.
Put performs the unchecked balance addition acc.balance += msg.value.
Put invokes LogFile.AddMessage after updating the balance.
Collect reads msg.sender for the account lookup and as call recipient.
Collect uses the _am parameter in the transfer and balance update.
Collect loads the local storage reference acc for the checks.
Local acc aliases Acc[msg.sender] state variable.
Collect gate depends on now > acc.unlockTime, a timestamp dependency.
Collect reaches the low-level call.value(_am)() transfer.
msg.sender is the target of the external value call and can re-enter.
acc.balance -= _am is executed only after the external call returns, enabling reentrancy balance manipulation.
Successful external call triggers LogFile.AddMessage as a cross-contract callback.
The subtraction writes back into the local acc reference (Acc[msg.sender]).
Fallback function delegates to Put(0).
Constructor reads the log address parameter.
Constructor assigns the LogFile state variable.
AddMessage writes fields into the LastMsg state struct.
AddMessage pushes LastMsg into the History state array.
AddMessage stamps LastMsg.Time with now, a timestamp dependency.
AddMessage consumes the _adr parameter.
AddMessage consumes the _val parameter.
AddMessage consumes the _data parameter.
ALFA_BANK reaches Log.AddMessage through the external LogFile contract reference.

normalization_plan.reason: Parameter _unlockTime is only used inside Put, so it folds into the Put core function node.
Parameter _am is only used inside Collect, so it folds into the Collect core function node.
Parameter log is only used by the ALFA_BANK constructor, so it folds into that core function node.
Parameter _adr is only used inside AddMessage, so it folds into the AddMessage core function node.
Parameter _val is only used inside AddMessage, so it folds into the AddMessage core function node.
Parameter _data is only used inside AddMessage, so it folds into the AddMessage core function node.
Local storage reference acc in Put is a direct alias of the state mapping and lives entirely in Put.
Local storage reference acc in Collect is a direct alias of the state mapping and lived only in Collect.
